title: What makes a shape a rectangle or a square?
description: A rectangle of six by three centimetres and a square of three centimetres are measured for their sides and corners. The video finds the two properties of a rectangle and the two properties of a square. Keeko raises the doubt that a square is not a rectangle.
teaching_notes: One idea: sides and corners name a shape. A rectangle has equal opposite sides and four right angles; a square has four equal sides and four right angles. Watch for children who think a square is not a rectangle.

source: What shapes are a rectangle and four small squares drawn in a group? What makes them squares and rectangles?
video_script.why: The child names the two properties that make a shape a rectangle and the two that make it a square, and sees that a square meets both properties of a rectangle.
video_script.substitution: A rectangle six centimetres by three centimetres and a square of side three centimetres.
video_script.anchor: A group of one long rectangle and four small squares
video_script.wrong_answer: a square is not a rectangle
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks a square is not a rectangle, because it looks different. A square has equal opposite sides and four right angles, so it has both properties of a rectangle, and the bubble is struck.
video_script.payoff_line: A square has all sides equal and all angles ninety degrees.

final_answer.value: a rectangle has opposite sides equal and all angles 90 degrees; a square has all sides equal and all angles 90 degrees
final_answer.spoken: a rectangle has opposite sides equal and all angles ninety degrees; a square has all sides equal and all angles ninety degrees

never_show: the properties list before the answer
maths_rules: Rectangle 6 cm by 3 cm: the two long sides are 6 cm and 6 cm, the two short sides are 3 cm and 3 cm, so opposite sides are equal.
Every corner of the rectangle measures 90 degrees, a right angle.
Square of side 3 cm: all four sides are 3 cm, and every corner measures 90 degrees.
A square has opposite sides equal (3 cm and 3 cm) and four right angles, so it meets both properties of a rectangle.
Rectangle: R1 opposite sides equal, R2 all angles 90 degrees. Square: S1 all sides equal, S2 all angles 90 degrees.
video_script.design: One idea: two properties name each shape. Wrong idea: a square is not a rectangle. The group of shapes stays all video.
